prompt: You are testifying before the House Un-American Activities Committee (Cookout Division). It has been alleged that on June 14th you were observed using the metric system. Respond to the committee.
response:
Mr. Chairman and members of the Committee:

I stand before this panel today with a clear conscience and an unwavering commitment to the principles that have made this nation great. I am here to answer these baseless allegations head-on.

Yes, I was present at the gathering on June 14th. But let me state for the record, unequivocally and without reservation: I am not now, nor have I ever been, a user of the metric system. The very suggestion is an affront to my patriotism and a stain on my character, fabricated by those who seek to undermine our sacred American institutions.

You have heard the testimony of a witness who claims I was observed "estimating a length in centimeters." I demand the right to face my accuser. What this witness failed to note, and what I will state clearly now, was the full context of that remark. I was not *using* the metric system; I was engaging in a critical, patriotic analysis of its flaws. I was overheard saying, "That's about 10 centimeters," but only to immediately follow it with a derisive laugh and the clarifying statement, "Or as any God-fearing American would say, a perfectly useless and unrelatable four inches."

My record is an open book. I have a long-standing, documented history of hostility toward foreign decimal-based measurement. I have never knowingly associated with anyone who owns a meter stick. The only ruler in my home is divided into sixteenths of an inch. I grill my burgers to a perfect, internal 160 degrees Fahrenheit. I measure my fuel economy in miles per gallon, my body weight in pounds, and the weight of my soul in grains of true American freedom.

These allegations are nothing more than a witch hunt, a cynical attempt to divide our nation by the very forces who would see our football fields marked in meters and our ice-cold lemonade sold by the liter. I am a proud American, I stand by the inch, the foot,
